Check that the amount is in the token’s smallest units, that the network and asset are the ones you mean, that CORS exposes the header, and that HEAD returns 402 too. Every command below runs against this store’s own paywall, so you can try them right now and compare with your endpoint. Prefer a browser? The free x402 endpoint checker runs all of these checks (and a few more) in one go. Set the URL once: URL=https://x402-seller-kit.soloearn.workers.dev/download 1. articles.title: Word Formatting Shortcuts: 6 Keys for Clean Report Layouts
articles.excerpt: Laying out a report with the mouse means a lot of trips to the ribbon: select the title, find the center button, select the date, find align right, open the font size list, pick a size, repeat. Each t…
articles.body: Laying out a report with the mouse means a lot of trips to the ribbon: select the title, find the center button, select the date, find align right, open the font size list, pick a size, repeat. Each trip is a second or two, and a report has dozens of them. Six shortcuts cover most of that work. TL;DR: Ctrl+E, Ctrl+] and Ctrl+[, Ctrl+R, Shift+Enter, Ctrl+B / I / U, Ctrl+Shift+8. The shortcuts Ctrl+E centers. On the title line, press it and the title is centered. Ctrl+] and Ctrl+[ change the size. Select text, then Ctrl+] makes the font one step bigger and Ctrl+[ one step smaller. Handy when you're judging by eye rather than picking a number. Ctrl+R aligns right. Put the cursor on the date or author line and press it. Shift+Enter starts a new line in the same paragraph.

articles.excerpt: Background removal on low-contrast product photos should start with the least complex useful fix: preserve a lossless master, inspect the alpha matte before resizing, and improve subject-to-backdrop s…
articles.body: Background removal on low-contrast product photos should start with the least complex useful fix: preserve a lossless master, inspect the alpha matte before resizing, and improve subject-to-backdrop separation at capture time when possible. For fintech hardware catalogs, that protects pale card-reader edges and translucent status windows while leaving bandwidth optimization until the derivative stage. TL;DR: Treat a bad cutout as an evidence problem before treating it as a compression problem. Compare the source, matte, composite, and delivered derivative; log measurements for each stage; then choose the smallest intervention supported by the evidence.

articles.title: Excel Table Shortcuts: 7 Keys That Replace Mouse Dragging
articles.excerpt: Dragging the mouse down a long column to select it usually ends one of two ways: you overshoot into empty rows, or you stop short and start over. Scrolling to find the last row of a table is the same…
articles.body: Dragging the mouse down a long column to select it usually ends one of two ways: you overshoot into empty rows, or you stop short and start over. Scrolling to find the last row of a table is the same story. None of it is hard, but it adds up over a day of spreadsheet work. These seven shortcuts cover most of the moving, selecting and filtering people normally do with the mouse. TL;DR: Ctrl+Down, Ctrl+Shift+Down, Ctrl+Space, Ctrl+Enter, Alt+Enter, Ctrl+Shift+L, Alt+Down. The shortcuts Ctrl+Down jumps to the end of the data. From A2, it goes straight to the last filled row (A26 in the example sheet) without scrolling. Ctrl+Shift+Down selects to the end. From D2, it selects D2 through D26, all 25 cells, in one press. Ctrl+Space selects the entire column.

articles.title: 29,139 vs 30,370: Gemini CLI 0.63 Ships 2 Plan-Mode Prompts, and Your TTY Picks Which
articles.excerpt: There is an old gemini-cli bug that reads like a model problem and isn't one. Issue #28913: run gemini -p "..." -y in a script, let the agent drift into Plan Mode, and the run ends by itself. No error…
articles.body: There is an old gemini-cli bug that reads like a model problem and isn't one. Issue #28913 : run gemini -p "..." -y in a script, let the agent drift into Plan Mode, and the run ends by itself. No error, no crash — the model emits one paragraph of text, calls no tools, and the process exits. In non-interactive mode a text-only response is a termination signal, so the agent politely waiting for approval looks exactly like "I'm done." The fix shipped in 0.63 as #29539 , fix(core): enable autonomous plan execution in non-interactive mode . I wanted to see what the fix actually changed, so I pointed 0.63.0 at a local mock endpoint and captured the real systemInstruction twice — once with no TTY, once inside one. Same binary. Same --approval-mode plan . Different prompt.

articles.title: TB 26-08 Complex Modes in Lightly Damped Structural Systems: A Two-Mode Interaction Perspective
articles.excerpt: For more information, contact Joel W. Sills, Langley Research Center, joel.w.sills@nasa.gov Download the PDF version Complex mode shapes can emerge in a linear structure even when overall damping is l…
articles.body: For more information, contact Joel W. Sills, Langley Research Center, joel.w.sills@nasa.gov Download the PDF version Complex mode shapes can emerge in a linear structure even when overall damping is low. This behavior can occur when two structural modes are closely spaced in frequency and are coupled through nonproportional damping. As the damping interaction increases, the two modal frequencies move toward one another while the mode shapes become increasingly complex. At a critical interaction level, the two frequencies coalesce. Beyond this point, the frequencies remain approximately equal while the modal decay rates separate. At very strong interaction, the mode shapes become approximately real again, but as different combinations of the original uncoupled modes.

articles.body: In a milestone achievement, NASA's Perseverance Mars rover has broken the record for most miles driven on a world beyond Earth. On Oct. 11, Perseverance hit 28.10 miles (45.22 kilometers) traveled on Mars, breaking the record previously held by NASA's Opportunity rover which went 28.06 miles (45.16 km). It took Oppy 14 years to cover all that ground; Perseverance, by contrast, has been on Mars for just 5.5 years. The new record is far from the end of Perseverance's journey, however; the mission team thinks the rover could eventually more than double the distance it's already traveled. "Our original design was only planned to last for [about] 20 kilometers of driving," Mark Maimone, a rover driver at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) in Southern California, told Space.com .
